title: SyllableLM: Learning Coarse Semantic Units for Speech Language Models

layout.note: One left-to-right chain: input waveform, the LossPred heat map over a transcript and spectrogram, the waveform cut at boundaries, a dashed SylBoost frame with the teacher-student block on the left and a self-similarity matrix on the right, then a stack of unit-ID boxes. The three bold stage titles run along the bottom edge and one long return arrow loops over the top back to Iter N.

lesson: Follow one real utterance through the method by printing the same time-aligned transcript under every heat map, so boundaries line up across stages, and show iteration with a single long return arrow into a dashed Iter N box.
